title: Robbot's Discord logs
description: This plugin makes logging your minecraft server easy!!
body:
Robbot | Discord logs

This plugin is the easiest way to set up logs for your Minecraft server. It’s simple, fast, and ready to use right away.

How to Set Up
Place the .jar file in your server’s plugins folder.

Start your server. After it loads, a new folder called RBDiscord will appear.

Open that folder and edit the configuration file inside to add your webhook and any other settings you need.

Restart your server, and your logs will now be fully connected.

Commands
/rbdiscord — Shows a list of available commands

/rbdiscord test — Tests whether your webhook is working correctly

/rbdiscord reload — Reloads the plugin configuration


Logs:

player join/leave.

player chat.

player death.

player advancements.

player teleport.

player level.

player damage.

block break/place.

crafting.

explosions.

weather changes.

time changes.

player commands.

console commands.

plugin events.


**If you experience any problems/feedback with this plugin, please join my Discord server and submit a ticket explaining your issue/feedback so I can fix it as quickly as possible.**
